svg.title: noderaven: a year of contributions surveyed as terrain
svg.desc: Topographic map of 2,178 GitHub contributions from 2 Nov 2025 to 7 Nov 2026. Each day is a survey point; busy days rise into hills. 8 on 12 Mar 2026, 109 on 24 Jun 2026, 158 on 15 Oct 2026, 101 on 11 Oct 2026.
svg.text: A year of commits, surveyed as terrain
I harden identity, Microsoft 365 and endpoints, study how
systems break, and build the tools that come out of it.
2,178 contributions, 2 Nov 2025 to 7 Nov 2026. Surveyed 7 Nov 2026 by GitHub Actions.

g.text: Contours rise with each day’s commits
